issues.description: Default pipeline points at data/stories, but the checkout has no story files, so extraction/demo cannot run from clean state.
generate-stories requires loading data/stories/manifest.json before generation, making first-time dataset generation impossible.
The only story dataset test is skipped when data is missing, so CI can pass while the advertised demo path is broken.
from_pretrained uses dtype while the declared transformers minimum may require torch_dtype, risking runtime incompatibility.
mean_activations can divide by zero for one-token inputs because effective_start can equal sequence length.
all_token_activations always drops token 0 as BOS without checking offsets, which corrupts activations for tokenizers that do not add BOS.
pca_components divides by total variance without handling zero-variance inputs, producing NaNs for constant neutral activations.
parse_story_block treats any preamble before the first <NEW STORY> delimiter as a story, contaminating generated datasets.
Story generation HTTP calls have no timeout, so a stalled API request can hang the pipeline indefinitely.
load_vectors trusts stale artifacts without validating manifest compatibility with the current config or loaded model.
Logit-lens markdown writes raw decoded tokens into table cells, so tokens containing pipes or newlines can corrupt the report.
Generated outputs and egg-info are ignored but present in the workspace, which makes source vs artifact ownership ambiguous.
